digest.component_or_area: Bedrock provider parity harness and verification
propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids must be proven invokable in the project's AWS account (896586841071/us-east-1) before corpus spend, with per-slot probes for bare calls and temperature=0 requests.

The same logical LLM call must produce equivalent request payloads across direct Anthropic and Bedrock providers, with identical system prompts, messages, and tool definitions modulo provider-required envelope differences.
The tool set offered to the model must be identical across both providers for the same call, proven by captured outbound requests rather than code inspection alone.
Provider routing must be provider-clean: a Bedrock-configured run must make zero calls to non-Bedrock providers, measured via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tally.

Any capability difference that legitimately alters the request payload must be explicit and recorded in the configuration rather than silent, such as temperature withdrawal on models with supports_temperature=False.
